source: Own measurement on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 2, 12 episodes, 2 per unit) with this build's grader (the controller's own time as the budget, the numerics pin and its fingerprint, the reference without a wall-clock limit): the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) scored credit 1.0 on each of the 12 episodes in each of its three wire runs at the selection (2026-11-21, tests/hidden/episode_selection.json: 36 runs, each with its own probe schedule, mean 1.0). In the graded order with the grader's own probe schedule, through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505) on Docker, `ale validate` of the commit before this note (validate-864f1632, 2026-11-22) measured mean_episode_credit 0.9944: 11 episodes at 1.0 and one at 0.9333 (one lane correct but not faced), 12 of 12 scored, no aborts, no simulation faults, probe pairs 528 of 528, the controller's own time 107 s of the 9000 s budget, the verify stage 1638 s; untouched 0.0. `value` is the credit's maximum, which the reference reached in every selection run; draw 1's measurements (five validates at 1.0) were of the earlier set and files (tests/NOTICE.md).
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json, draw 2). full_at 0.98: the reference's 0.9944 in the graded order (one lane's facing lost: 0.2 / 3 of one episode's credit, 0.0056 of the metric) gives it reward 1.0; two such losses (0.9889) still would.
